## What's new

- **Tiles in two colourings:** automap edits and custom DT1s copy every version of a tile. If the map loaded two copies of a library at the time (one converted to other colours), both versions ended up in the new DT1. The game then shows one at random per cell, for example purple-speckled door frames on some doors. These versions use only Act 0 colours, so "Make act-safe" called them safe.
  - The Compatibility check now warns "N tiles have two versions in different colours".
  - "Make act-safe" now shows a note about them.
  - Both offer "Compare the versions and choose…": the versions are shown large, side by side. Click the right one, and the others are taken out of the DT1 (the old file is kept as .bak).
- **Prevention:** an automap edit now stops with an explanation when a tile comes from two differently coloured copies of a library. Choose a copy first.
- The "Choose which copy to keep" dialog is unchanged.
